title: senecio jacobaea subsp. nemorosus
intro: Senecio jacobaea subsp. nemorosus, commonly known as Woodland Ragwort or Narrow-leaved Ragwort, is a subspecies of the ragwort plant. It is a perennial plant that belongs to the daisy family and is known for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Senecio jacobaea subsp. nemorosus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
